brief: A full catalogue of every project verified on 2026-10-12: 12 entries (8 live, 5 client, 1 this-site + 2 repository- /tool-only). The three directions — Atlas, Dossier, Broadsheet — each share the same dark #0A0A0A + gold #D4AF37 world and the same curated data, organized differently.

candidates.name: Atlas
candidates.concept: Map-room console: layers rail + plot grid + dossier pane. The catalogue itself IS the first screen; selecting a plot loads its dossier inline.
candidates.typography: JetBrains Mono 400–500 (UI/data) · Inter 400–600 (prose) · Playfair Display 600 (dossier titles)

candidates.name: Dossier
candidates.concept: Archival file of the catalogue rendered as ruled index cards in a darkened reading room. Gold is stamp ink only. Each file row carries a memory stamp (upper-left corner) and two-column plate/record layout.
candidates.typography: Playfair Display 600 (headings) · JetBrains Mono 400 (serials, labels) · Space Grotesk 400–500 (body)
traits: alternating file rows with plate + record

candidates.name: Broadsheet
candidates.concept: The catalogue typeset as one sheet of newsprint in the night palette: lead story + 3-column body + running ticker of live sites at the bottom. The lead story's plate plays on hover→video.
